LanguageData.Shion_GameStartDialog: You did not come here under orders, nor were you exiled. The three of you chose this place and brought only what three people could carry: your bodies, records, tools, and a finite industrial reserve. The homeland's abundance is far away. Its knowledge is not. Build a shelter, restore local production, and make a good life that belongs to this place.
